description: Railway underbridges over farm tracks that the open lidar shows and OpenStreetMap lacks. Each is a notch through the embankment in the bare-earth DTM (the ground filter drops a bridge deck to the ground beneath) with the DSM (first returns) at the embankment's crest across it: a deck. Adopted ones are bridge spans in the windows' trail profiles (scripts/build_section_data.py) and register structures (scripts/lidar_underbridges.py --register).
method: scripts/lidar_underbridges.py --measure: the 1 m DTM and DSM along the OSM centreline, 60 m either side of the centre; the notch is where the DTM is more than 1 m below the chord between the window's ends; the span is the notch widened by 3 m each end for the abutments. Cross-sections every 2 m along and 4 m across (24 m either side) show each notch running through the embankment to the ground on both sides, as at the OSM-mapped underbridge at km 9.16 (way/159029124).

sources.lidar: Welsh Government / NRW lidar DTM and DSM, 1 m, 32-bit COGs (Open Government Licence), retrieved 2026-11-02
sources.corroboration: Gwynedd Council map captures (OS MasterMap base, Crown copyright, OS licence AC0000821460), captured 2026-11-02: the bridge symbol over a track at each place. Evidence only: no position, line or outline was taken from them (data/source-register.md).

fields: notchM: the notch on the centreline (m along the route); dtmDipM: its depth below the chord; floorM, crestM: the DTM at its floor and the chord there (m OD); dsmOverNotchM: the DSM over the notch, [min, median] (m OD)
